verdict.rationale: Google Drive is a SaaS platform with developer documentation, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The probe returned HTTP 404 for developers.google.com/llms.txt, and nothing in the pack describes docs written for agent consumption. The Discovery API document and the ADK add-on guide are a machine-readable API spec and an agent-building tutorial, not agent-oriented documentation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
